title: In multiple functions of ipphelper.c, there is a possible stack bugger overflow due to a missing… (CVE-2026-58853)
description: CVE-2026-58853 is a high-severity vulnerability involving a possible stack buffer overflow in multiple functions of the ipphelper.c source file due to missing bounds checks. This flaw allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service without requiring user interaction or additional privileges.
